intro.text: I have been a self taught web developer since 2018. In 2022, after school, I got my first job as a professional Web Dev. While Traditional WebDev is still in my heart, today I'm increasingly doing more and more AI and ML in the web projects. I am a builder at heart and love creating diverse web experiences. Working with me, you can expect many rapid prototypes to explore new ideas with creative twists.

projects.title: Shopify Search
projects.description: I created a Search engine across shopify stores. This includes 580k products. I added functionality for Semantic search and content based Recommender system.
